keywords: Partition action – Appeal against interlocutory decree in partition proceedings – Allotment of shares among co-owners – Failure to allot shares transferred by deeds produced in evidence – Whether deeds tendered and marked at trial should be recognized in the partition decree – Erroneous finding that deeds were not tendered to court – Amendment of interlocutory decree to reflect transfers established by documentary and oral evidence – Adjustment and reallocation of shares transferred by parties pendente lite – Whether amendments to the decree would prejudice rights of other parties – Remittal to District Court for amendment of decree and issuance of commission for final partition.
legistation: Partition Law No. 16 of 1951 (as amended), Civil Procedure Code.
